blocks.raw: DriveWealth enables all investors to vote their shares in proxy voting opportunities—even fractional shareholders. Once the voting window has elapsed, all votes for all customers are aggregated and reported to voting tabulators. For any customers who do not vote their shares, DriveWealth submits a broker abstention vote.
